channel.title: MassPermits Research
channel.description: Original analysis of Massachusetts building-permit records. Every figure recomputed from the live data, with the method published alongside.

item.title: Friday is the quietest day in Massachusetts permit records - and in one town it does not exist
item.description: Across 37,364 Massachusetts building permits from 31 municipal sources, Friday accounts for 12.8% of dated records against roughly 22.3% on Tuesday. In Hingham it is zero.

item.title: We could only answer the heat-pump question in 10 of 31 Massachusetts towns
item.description: Across 501 heating-system permits in the 10 Massachusetts towns whose records can answer, heat pumps are 35.1% of installations - and range from 20.0% to 46.7%.

item.title: We found 136 accessory-dwelling-unit permits in Massachusetts records - and the apparent boom is not real
item.description: 136 ADU permits across 18 Massachusetts towns. Raw monthly counts climb from 1 to 37, but normalized against the same sources the rate is flat. 25.0% mention a garage.

item.title: What 31 Massachusetts towns publish in their permit records
item.description: Every one of the 31 Massachusetts municipal sources behind MassPermits, what each publishes, and what it does not - 20 publish no project value and 2 publish coordinates.

item.title: Methodology - how MassPermits measures Massachusetts permit data
item.description: How MassPermits collects Massachusetts building-permit records, how work is classified, what is deliberately withheld, and the four rules every research page on this site follows.

item.title: Corrections and rejected analyses
item.description: Corrections and rejected analyses. Every figure MassPermits computed, verified and then declined to publish, with the reason it did not survive.
